resourceClasses.rationale: Published reference tables carry no personal data and over-blocking them strands every downstream join. Serving an unclassified reference column is a known, bounded exposure that the data steward accepted on the record.
Default. An unclassified column in an internal analytics surface is more likely to be an un-onboarded field than a deliberately open one.
Customer master is where the personal data is. A column we cannot classify is exactly the column not to serve.
